scope_rule: Catalogue identity is original1970 article plus separately identified corrections; do not equate generic hyperbolic, later E-nu or E-B implementations with original without source comparison

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Exact original equation and axial/confining stress definitions
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Typed stress/strain relation with explicit tangent versus secant outputs

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Exact pressure normalization, exponent, stress measure and applicable path
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Positive stress scales, dimensionless ratios and declared numerical domain

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Exact modulus law, branch predicate, memory maximum and return-to-primary rule
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Named branch and committed history, not modulus chosen from current sign alone

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Exact original closure, constants and admissible interval, including any correction
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Complete compliance/stiffness action and singularity guards
source_to_schema_questions.status: Unverified; no constant Poisson assumption supplied

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Original definitions and relationship between fitted asymptote and failure stress
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Distinct quantities and explicit endpoint/postfailure behavior

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Original procedures, specimen conditions, drainage basis, figures/table values and units
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Source-located calibration record separate from implementation defaults
source_to_schema_questions.status: No parameter values or ranges admitted

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Original triaxial/plane-strain/FE text, general tensor equations and principal-stress assumptions
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Explicit supported dimension and path; general3D requires source closure
source_to_schema_questions.status: Do not certify triaxial-only or complete3D from title/abstract

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Compression sign, total/effective stresses, engineering/tensor shear and small/finite strain definitions
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Explicit mapping before any Atlas Mandel conversion

source_to_schema_questions.required_source: Reference confining state, initial strain, preloading/unloading memory and equilibrium preparation
source_to_schema_questions.schema_requirement_if_confirmed: Input recipe with independent memory values and admissibility checks

project_requirements_not_source_claims: Immutable committed parent for every trial
Rollback all state after failure and cutback
Separate algorithmic tangent from physical tangent and secant modulus
Record actual path, stress constraints, units and source version
Do not introduce physical-time creep or rate independence without inspecting original text

gating_questions: Does original supply multiaxial compliance or only test-path tangent relationships?
Which stress/history measure controls loading versus unloading/reloading?
What changes in1971 correction and does it affect constitutive or illustrative numerical content?
How are nonproportional paths, principal-direction rotation and tension handled, if at all?
Is a strain-controlled inversion unique within declared path and domain?
capability_policy: No new generic primitive or state capacity request before exact source equations justify one
proposed_future_checks_not_executed: Differentiate exact verified primary hyperbola and compare tangent against declared secant at several strains
Verify initial-slope and large-strain limits within original admissible range
Hold confining pressure fixed, integrate primary tangent independently and compare original stress-strain relation
Unload/reload from a prepared committed parent and test exact original rejoin condition
Compare caller partition, reversal localization, failed-trial rollback and zero increment only after branch law is pinned
Distinguish axial/triaxial reproduction from any later full3D extension
